HOW I GOT STARTED 👩🏻‍🔧 i get this question all the time — I haven’t really told my full story because it felt heavy, but I think it’s time to share.

My dad was a home builder + electrical contractor and growing up we always built wild science fair projects together and he showed me the power of tools to bring ideas to life. 

After loosing him to cancer 💔 I decided to dive in without fear and teach myself how to transform my first home — tackling projects SOLO — since he wasn’t there to teach me how.

I was raised to know that girls can do anything 💪 I’m teaching mine the same, and I’m here to help you learn too! Follow along for tutorials + projects and let’s cheer each other on through epic diys! @neverskipbrunch

p.s. my other favorite part of this journey has been meeting my bestie @eyeinthedetail — that story is hilarious so we’ll share that soon too 👩🏻‍🔧👩🏼‍🔧
